abstract: Plans and executes migrating an existing web app, PWA, or SPA into a store-ready Capacitor iOS and Android app: audit, static build, Capacitor 8.5+ shell, native-feeling UX against guideline 4.2, plugins and permissions, account deletion, IAP vs web billing, Apple SDK and Google Play target API deadlines, closed testing, Capgo live updates, verification, and common failure fixes.
triggers: convert web app to mobile app
